name: Zoom Grid
description: A grid of image cards where choosing one brings it forward and large while the rest of the grid dims behind it.

props.name: cards
props.type: { id: string; src: string; title: string; description: ReactNode; alt?: string; className?: string }[]
props.description: The cards. className sets each card's span in the grid with container variants, for example @2xl:col-span-2.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the close button on the open card.

props.name: backdropBlur
props.description: Blurs the page behind the scrim. Off by default: the browser redraws the blur on every frame while anything behind it changes, which stalls on large pages, most of all in Firefox.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the outer element. It is a size container with three columns from 42rem wide, and the open card is centred inside it.
